title: MV looking for a quest journal plugin!

posts.author: oddgamedev1
posts.body:
im trying to find a good plugin that tracks your quests and tasks in the game, i heard there is YEP's questjournal plugin but i'm pretty sure it's not free and i dont really wanna purchase a bundle of plugins just for that specific one anyway-
but if there are alternates to that plugin that are free please let me know!!!!
thanks in advance!

posts.author: Cenewulf_TTV
posts.body:
https://galvs-scripts.com/2016/11/11/mv-quest-log/
This one is free and one that I am using in my game
Hope this helps bud o7

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
PKD SimpleQuestJournal
is a nice one include trackers.
there is another one which is far more complicated, but also complete
but can't find this one at this point (but it has also a tracker) basicly
everything a quest log can have.
Edit found it: [
High Quality Quest System
]
it hasn't trackers like PKD, but it has everything you need.
this may be the most complex one, or easy to setup, but you have
everything you need here.
GS_QuestSystem
is nice too which can add image on completed/failed.
